            "V": "(I + eta + V**2 + c_glob0*cr + c_glob1*cv - np.pi**2*r**2*tau**2 + J*r*tau*(1 - A))/tau",

    use_numba = False

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        A = state_variables[0, :]
        B = state_variables[1, :]
        V = state_variables[2, :]
        r = state_variables[3, :]

        Delta = self.Delta
        I = self.I
        J = self.J
        alpha = self.alpha
        cr = self.cr
        cv = self.cv
        eta = self.eta
        tau_A = self.tau_A
        tau = self.tau

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        c_glob0 = coupling[0, :]
        c_glob1 = coupling[1, :]

        # Derived Variables

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(B / tau_A),  # A
            np.asarray((-A - 2 * B + alpha * r) / tau_A),  # B
            np.asarray(
                (
                    I
                    + eta
                    + V**2
                    + c_glob0 * cr
                    + c_glob1 * cv
                    - np.pi**2 * r**2 * tau**2
                    + J * r * tau * (1 - A)
                )
                / tau
            ),  # V
            np.asarray((2 * V * r + Delta / (np.pi * tau)) / tau),  # r
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
